title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_5
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing various reports, memoranda, and correspondence regarding flying saucers, including several claimed encounters with craft and occupants. / This file contains various reports of flying saucer sightings and hoaxes, which the FBI consistently referred to the Air Force or OSI.

encounters.summary: A pilot reported observing a bright yellow, rocket-shaped object approximately 15-18 inches long, traveling at high speed near Parkersburg, West Virginia.
encounters.entity_appearance: bright canary yellow, rocket-shaped, needle nose, blunt rear, vertical and horizontal fins
encounters.entity_behavior: traveling at high speed, dropping slightly
encounters.quote: bright yellow object coming directly towards me

encounters.summary: A lecturer at Denver University claimed to have observed crashed flying saucers in New Mexico and recovered human-like occupants approximately three feet tall.
encounters.quote: occupants of saucers described by him as of human form, but about three feet tall

encounters.summary: An informant reported observing a circular object with three-foot tall occupants in metallic cloth suits recovered in New Mexico.
encounters.entity_appearance: human shape, three feet tall, metallic cloth suits
encounters.quote: three bodies of human shape but only 3 feet tall, dressed in metallic cloth

encounters.summary: Miss Laura McChesney observed a silvery white, diamond-shaped object traveling west at high speed near Geneva, Illinois.
Elmira Police Department reported a landed object near the airport, which was identified by the Resident Agent as a corrugated cardboard box with a radio tube and flare.
Naval personnel reported multiple sightings of unidentified objects, including radar interference and visual sightings of fast-moving orange lights and fireballs.
Douglas Harrison observed a cigar-shaped, silver object at high altitude moving east over Washington, D.C.
Tage Stensig, a meteorologist, observed a large, bright, silvery object moving at high speed over Downers Grove, Illinois.
An informant observed a cigar-shaped object with a glowing front and dark rear traveling at high speed over the Great Lakes Naval Training Center.
Walter D. Jones observed a hazy, light-emitting object circling over his farm near Toronto for 35 minutes.
